title: SCOPE: Semantic Bounded Credit Optimization for Prompt Engineering in Text-to-image Generation
title_zh: 范围：文本到图像生成中提示工程的语义边界信用优化

paragraphs.en: SCOPE是一种基于群体相对策略优化的目标函数，用于改进文本到图像生成的提示工程。 Reinforcement learning (RL) enables language models to improve text-to-image (T2I) generation by rewriting prompts for a frozen image generator. Existing methods typically apply a single signal derived from the image to individual subword tokens, although objects, counts, attributes, and relations form coherent semantic spans. We propose SCOPE, an objective based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that aligns update weighting with this structure. The rewriter jointly generates an enhanced prompt and its semantic partition. SCOPE pools shifts in policy log probabilities within each span to derive a shared coefficient for its token losses while retaining a single advantage for each completion. It requires neither separate span rewards nor additional image renders. Across Qwen-Image, SD3, and FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE achieves average relative gains over vanilla GRPO of 9.48% on GeneVal and 7.62% on T2I-CompBench. Ablation studies show that both semantic boundaries and pooling within spans contribute to these gains, supporting semantic structure as a practical inductive bias for prompt engineering with RL.
paragraphs.zh: SCOPE是一种基于群体相对策略优化的目标函数，用于改进文本到图像生成的提示工程。强化学习（RL）使语言模型能够通过为冻结的图像生成器改写提示来改进文本到图像（T2I）生成。 现有方法通常将来自图像的单一信号应用到单个子词词元上，而实际上对象、数量、属性和关系构成连贯的语义片段。 我们提出SCOPE，一种基于群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的目标函数，使更新权重与这种结构对齐。 改写器联合生成一个增强的提示及其语义划分。 SCOPE将每个片段内策略对数概率的偏移进行池化，为其词元损失推导出一个共享系数，同时为每个补全保留单一的优势值。 它既不需要单独的片段奖励，也不需要额外的图像渲染。 在Qwen-Image、SD3和FLUX.1-dev上，SCOPE相比原始GRPO在GeneVal上取得9.48%、在T2I-CompBench上取得7.62%的平均相对提升。 消融实验表明，语义边界和片段内池化都对上述提升有贡献，这支持将语义结构作为强化学习提示工程中一种实用的归纳偏置。
